ctx.x: I thought so. I worked in it ... he had the greatest band in the world because that's the way he thought. And the way we got together, the way I got together with Smack, I had a little deal called the Left Hand Corner. That figured That's means the first note. I figured if you could interpret (Q) the first note, something must be happening for the rest of them, you know. So he appreciated my little idea and so we had pretty good style.
But, you were going to tell a story about Fats.
